title: DonkeyCar Vision Control
description: A DSC190 team project testing camera-based line and lane following with Python, OpenCV, and PID control. My work focused on the single-line follower and physical testing. The line follower completed three consecutive laps on our course track.

title: Income and Voter Participation
description: A COGS108 team project studying the association between neighborhood income and voter participation in California in 2022 and 2024. I contributed to research question design and data curation.

title: League of Legends Match Analysis
description: A DSC80 course project analyzing professional League of Legends match data with pandas and Plotly. I explored missing data, hypothesis testing, and match-outcome classification using logistic regression and gradient boosting.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: A personal portfolio website built for DSC106 using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It includes project cards loaded from JSON, a theme selector, and GitHub profile statistics fetched from an API.
